title: Adaptive Turn-Taking for Real-time Multi-Party Voice Agents
title_zh: 面向实时多方语音 Agent 的自适应轮次接管
abstract_en: Turn-taking in multi-party spoken conversations remains a fundamental challenge for voice-based agents, particularly under dynamic floor competition and varying user expectations. We propose ModeratorLM, a role-playing voice agent that conditions turn-taking behavior on an explicitly assigned role in multi-party settings. The system is built on a speech large language model operating in chunk-wise streaming manner. We further introduce a reasoning-augmented variant that incorporates chain-of-thought reasoning over conversational context and the assigned role. We construct RolePlayConv, a large-scale synthetic dataset of spoken multi-party conversations with diverse assistant roles. Experiments on real-world meeting data and RolePlayConv show improved turn-taking precision by over 40% and recall by more than 70%, while substantially reducing false-positive interruptions compared to non-role-conditioned baselines.
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦多方语音对话中的轮次接管（turn-taking）难题，尤其是在多人抢占话语权、用户期望动态变化的场景下。作者提出 ModeratorLM：一种基于角色扮演的语音 Agent，通过显式分配的角色来调节多方对话中的发言时机。系统建立在按语音块流式处理的 speech large language model 之上，并进一步提出结合 chain-of-thought reasoning 的增强版本，使模型能够基于对话上下文与指定角色进行推理。论文还构建了 RolePlayConv，一个包含多样助手角色的大规模合成多方语音对话数据集。在真实会议数据与 RolePlayConv 上，ModeratorLM 相比非角色条件基线将轮次接管 precision 提升超过 40%、recall 提升超过 70%，同时显著减少误打断。
key_points_zh: 提出 ModeratorLM，将显式角色分配引入多方语音 Agent 的 turn-taking 决策，使系统能根据“主持人、参与者、旁听者”等角色调整发言策略。
系统基于 chunk-wise streaming 的 speech large language model，适配实时语音输入，面向动态多方对话中的即时响应需求。
引入 reasoning-augmented 版本，通过 chain-of-thought reasoning 综合对话上下文与角色约束，提升何时插话、何时等待的判断能力。
构建 RolePlayConv 大规模合成多方语音对话数据集，覆盖多种助手角色，为角色条件化轮次接管训练与评测提供数据基础。
在真实会议数据和 RolePlayConv 上，相比非角色条件基线，turn-taking precision 提升超过 40%、recall 提升超过 70%，并显著降低误打断。

llm_assessment.comment: A highly relevant realtime voice-agent paper that tackles multi-party turn-taking, streaming speech interaction, interruption reduction, and reusable spoken-conversation data.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇高度契合实时语音智能体方向的论文，聚焦多人轮次管理、流式语音交互、减少误打断以及可复用的口语对话数据。
